title: OmniSat: Self-Supervised Modality Fusion for Earth Observation
claim: OmniSat demonstrates self-supervised modality fusion and single-modality inference for Earth observation, so generic multimodal fusion or missing-modality claims are not new.
evidence_excerpt: ECCV 2024 self-supervised modality fusion for Earth observation.

title: Bridging Remote Sensors with Multisensor Geospatial Foundation Models
claim: msGFM bridges remote sensors using co-located observations, sensor embeddings and cross-sensor masked prediction, establishing a strong aligned-sensor foundation prior.
evidence_excerpt: CVPR 2024 multisensor geospatial foundation model with sensor-specific embeddings and cross-sensor masked prediction.

title: SkySense: A Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Foundation Model Towards Universal Interpretation for Earth Observation Imagery
claim: SkySense establishes multimodal optical/SAR foundation representations with multi-granularity contrastive and geographic priors; multimodal VFM pretraining itself is not the contribution.
evidence_excerpt: CVPR 2024 multi-modal remote-sensing foundation model for universal interpretation.

title: AnySat: One Earth Observation Model for Many Resolutions, Scales, and Modalities
claim: AnySat provides a strong modality-, scale- and resolution-aware EO VFM prior and baseline, but its shared spatial layout does not by itself reject incorrect cross-modal correspondences.
evidence_excerpt: CVPR 2025 model for many Earth-observation resolutions, scales and modalities.

title: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
claim: TerraMind covers large-scale generative multimodality, token/pixel fusion and any-to-any modality generation; these broad operations are not a defensible new center under 3090 constraints.
evidence_excerpt: ICCV 2025 multimodal Earth-observation foundation model with token and pixel dual-scale fusion.

title: SkySense V2: A Unified Foundation Model for Multi-modal Remote Sensing
claim: SkySense V2 already covers unified backbone, modality prompts, adaptive patch merging and MoE; generic modality experts or prompts must be rejected as the core.
evidence_excerpt: ICCV 2025 unified multi-modal remote-sensing foundation model.

title: MAPEX: Modality-Aware Pruning of Experts for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
claim: MAPEX explicitly uses modality-conditioned token routing to experts and modality-aware pruning, so a generic modality token router is operationally crowded.
evidence_excerpt: MAPEX abstract states modality-conditioned token routing and modality-aware expert pruning.

title: RingMoE: Mixture-of-Modality-Experts Multi-Modal Foundation Models for Universal Remote Sensing Image Interpretation
claim: RingMoE establishes modality-specific, collaborative and shared experts with dynamic pruning; a large MoE bank is both crowded and infeasible for this project.
evidence_excerpt: Remote-sensing mixture-of-modality-experts foundation model with dynamic pruning.

title: STARS: Shared-specific Translation and Alignment for missing-modality Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
claim: STARS occupies shared/specific translation and alignment for missing-modality remote-sensing segmentation; missing modality cannot be the primary operating dimension.
evidence_excerpt: STARS abstract reports shared-specific translation, asymmetric alignment and semantic sampling for missing-modality segmentation.

title: MHFNet: Multimodal hybrid fusion framework for misaligned SAR-Optical ship detection
claim: MHFNet treats misaligned optical-SAR fusion with deformable alignment, content-guided attention and uncertainty-aware decision fusion; it is a strong problem near-art but not the same VFM partial-transport operation.
evidence_excerpt: ISPRS JPRS metadata and abstract describe misaligned SAR-optical ship detection and hybrid fusion.

title: SMAF-net: semantics-guided modality transfer and hierarchical feature fusion for optical-SAR image registration
claim: SMAF-net uses semantics-guided modality transfer and hierarchical fusion for optical-SAR registration; any CPTR claim must distinguish correspondence rejection/transport from registration or modality transfer.
evidence_excerpt: Optical-SAR registration paper with semantics-guided modality transfer and hierarchical feature fusion.

title: Adapter-Enhanced SAR-Optical Joint Segmentation With Primary Modality Regularization and Sparse Attention Adjustment
claim: Adapter-enhanced SAR-optical joint segmentation with primary-modality regularization and sparse attention is a decision-critical same-task near-art; full-text operation audit is mandatory before route freeze.
evidence_excerpt: Publisher abstract reports adapter fine-tuning, primary-modality regularization and adaptive sparse attention on WHU-OPT-SAR, DDHR and DFC2020.

title: GeoRL: Adaptive tokenization via reinforcement learning for remote sensing foundation models
